Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

M-RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models in Multilingual Settings (ACL-2025.acl-long.3-published) · paper method: The benchmark constructs 100 easy and 100 hard chosen/rejected translation pairs for each of four translation directions.

cohort7.claim.mreward.translation-pairs

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Easy pairs use highest/lowest ratings with an absolute human-score gap≥0.25; hard pairs use two of the remaining three translations with gap≥0.50.31 MAPLE prompt templates are sampled with replacement100 times; no pooled-language denominator is substituted.
